config.name: openset_ablation_no_pair_margin
config.description: Margin term only removed, contrastive retained. Separates which of the two metric objectives the rejection behaviour depends on.

probes.protocol: Embeddings from all three task splits are pooled and split 50/50 for the probe. The task's own partition is not reused, because a strict protocol makes the nuisance disjoint across it by construction.

tradeoff.reading: Nuisance leakage is the first number and task performance the second. A method that drives the first to zero while collapsing the second has not achieved invariance, it has destroyed the representation.
